name: Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument
story: Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument spans 87,563 acres of mountains and forestland in northern Penobscot County, Maine. President Barack Obama proclaimed the land as a national monument on August 24, 2016. Native animals found here include moose, bobcats, bald eagles, salmon, and Canada lynx.
matters: The monument is located on the eastern border of Maine's Baxter State Park and includes a section of the East Branch Penobscot River. The Penobscot Nation inhabited the area for more than 11,000 years.
